maker: Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics Co., Ltd. (Country Garden)
model: Threaded Rod Hanger Installation Robot (丝杆支架安装机器人)
name: Bright Dream threaded-rod hanger installation robot
summary: Robot that drills the ceiling and installs the threaded hanger rods for ducts, cable trays and light pipes in underground car parks, with line following, automatic feeding and rebar avoidance. Made by Bright Dream in Foshan.

germany.statusNote: No route for a German buyer. Bright Dream lists the robot only on its Chinese website, whose product detail pages are blank, and its global exclusive agent BrightMaster Robotics (BMR) does not offer it. No EU dealer, customer or CE marking found.

specs.label: Application
specs.value: threaded hanger rods for ducts, cable trays and light water pipes in car parks
specs.quote: 主要适用于地下车库中机电安装工程相关风管、电力线槽和较轻水管的丝吊杆安装作业

specs.label: Functions
specs.value: line following, automatic drilling, automatic feeding, rebar avoidance, obstacle stop, fault alarm
specs.quote: 具备巡线定位、自动打孔、自动上料、钢筋规避、安全停障、故障报警等功能

notes: Mechanism and drive not described; wheels assumed.
Bright Dream says 28 of its robot types are in commercial use; this one is listed as a product, but it is not offered by BMR.
